name: Breakfast and Bubbles
notes: not_found: San Diego Union-Tribune (Pam Kragen, 2024-06-14) confirms Breakfast & Bubbles at 3831 Park Blvd was forced to permanently close due to water damage; the operators reopened as a new concept, XOXO by Breakfast & Bubbles, at a different address in University Heights. The 3831 Park Blvd address itself is now occupied by an unrelated, differently-named successor, Origen (origencocina.com, dinner-only Mexican restaurant, same address confirmed). Independent closure confirmation plus a differently-named successor at the address.

No specific San Diego address given in the work list to target a single store.
